text:
Week 1 of the new plan. The account is +2.1% since Monday against the S&P 500 at +1.9%, so slightly ahead.
AMD (quality dip) +17% this week, about 11 points better than the market, and the clear winner. NVDA (quality dip) -15% this week, almost all of it company-specific (the CEO investigation) ahead of earnings on 17 Nov. It is still well above the 108.64 disaster stop.
SNOW and CRWD rose less than the market. Their limit sells expire today.
None of Monday's catch-up buys (VOO, MCK, ABBV, V, MA, KO) have been logged, so the account is 54% cash and the 30% index core is still empty.
Market light YELLOW (VIX 21). All sectors except gold rose this week; energy and industrials led.

cautions.why: Earnings 17 Nov plus the CEO investigation; the position is about 14% of the account.
